pos.personaBrief: Tabarez quotes that opponents had more possession in every 2010 game while Uruguay had more shots, and said possession does not win games (Chile 29%-71% win 2015); reactive, play according to the rival.

pro.personaBrief: Garra Charrua players, not precise on the ball; goals via set pieces and a long ball against Chile 2015; pragmatic and direct rather than patient build-up.

est.personaBrief: Balanced 4-4-2 with two compact lines and fixed roles, with defined duties; little evidence of rondo-style relational play, but shape is flexible between systems.

lar.personaBrief: Two defensive midfielders and full-back pushed forward; creative midfield feeds Cavani and Suarez through the center; 2018 Uruguay lacked depth wide.

blo.personaBrief: Compact two lines of four, deep defensive line, cautious pressing up high (Chile 2015), with selective high press on Ortigoza in the 2011 final.

mar.personaBrief: Rejects individual marking of Messi in 2021 and defends with compact lines; emphasis on zones where crosses come from; corner scheme not documented but zonal tendency.

pla.personaBrief: States Uruguay must play in function of the rival, limit it then create problems; changes system within games and corrects directives; but a long-held strategy underlies it.

res.personaBrief: Said if we can win without playing so nicely he is delighted; the path matters, but results and efficiency over beauty; defence and set pieces.

sis.personaBrief: Collective Garra Charrua and tactical duties for all (Cavani helps marking always); system and organization over stars, though Suarez and Cavani are key; players given freedom within obligations.

jog.personaBrief: Fighting, hard-working players who give no ball up for lost, ferocious central zone; set-piece goals; technique secondary.

bas.personaBrief: Built a youth structure proceso (players should be made in youth teams), but relied on a historic squad for years, few debuts 2010-14, experienced starting XI.

lid.personaBrief: Exigence and pause, gives players freedom inside obligations, defends his stars publicly; teacher figure with firm discipline.
